## Background
I was born and raised in Woodstock, a town in southwestern Ontario. I majored in Linguistics and Psychology and minored in Mathematics at the Universty of Toronto.

## Why data science?
When the Computational Linguistics program was brought to my attention, I realized this was an intersection of my most prominent skills and interests. It is also such a releant area to study as the effect of LLMs on our society only continues to grow. 

## More about me
I compete in a few martial arts, play guitar (especially rock), and read a range of genres.
